payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods for extracting textual patterns used in error generation, detailing how these patterns are derived from annotated corpora and utilized in generating errors.

claims.text: Textual patterns are extracted from an annotated corpus by identifying incorrect and correct phrase pairs, which are then used to generate errors in grammatically correct sentences.
Patterns are learned over words and part-of-speech tags, allowing for the generation of various types of errors beyond those previously studied.
The system uses transformation patterns to insert errors into correct sentences, based on the frequency of these patterns in the training data.
